image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Ankylosaurus from the libraries.characters.dino_racer_ankylosaurus config showing extreme exhaustion after winning. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Wide, squat frame; slate-grey stony armor; moss-green skin; cream side-spikes. Triangular head with four horns and amber eyes. ACTION: He is positioned behind the victory podium, leaning his massive weight heavily against it for support. His legs are splayed wide, and his chest is low to the ground. He is breathing heavily, with visible steam 'puffs' coming from his nostrils. His heavy head is resting its chin directly on the '1st Place' tier of the wooden podium. A red 'Winner' ribbon is tangled messily around his beak and one horn. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Happy but completely spent; eyes are half-closed and weary. SETTING: Finish line ceremony area; LANCE_HELL_CREEK. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with a damp, sweaty sheen on the pebbly skin. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-view.
